Noah G.: Follow-up from the 03/18 tail-latency postmortem. Need to assign remediation owners, set rollout windows, and pick how to treat SLO math while fixes land.
Zara L.: Ill take runtime (per-shard KV eviction + hotspot detection). ETA ~72h for a staged change and perf validation. Ill include extra shard metrics so we can validate at rollforward.
Ethan B.: Ill own autoscaling policy + dashboard updates. Plan: add a short burst token, shorten the scale-up cooldown to ~20s, and add an internal "operational threshold" tile for ops only. ETA ~48h.
Noah G.: On the SLO question: proposal is to keep public/customer SLO unchanged but use a temporary internal operational threshold = 280ms for ops/error-budget calculations for 14 days. Public dashboard will show an incident annotation pointing to the postmortem. Keeps customer SLAs intact and prevents noisy paging. Thoughts?
Zara L.: Sounds reasonable. Internal threshold for ops only. Ill add a flag to the SLO dashboard and annotate traces for the incident window.
Ethan B.: Agree. Ill add an ops-only alert in staging:
```
alert: OpsP95Threshold
expr: service:inference_p95_ms > 280
for: 5m
labels: {severity: "page"}
annotations: {runbook: "https://go/redwood/runbooks/kv-hotspots"}
```
Will push to staging dashboards and keep customer-facing alerts untouched.
OpsBot: Incident 2026-03-18 | estimated error-budget impact: 4.2% | current p95: 312ms | incident link: https://go/redwood/incident/2026-0318
Noah G.: Action items: Zara -> runtime PR + perf runs (3d) + trace annotations, Ethan -> autoscale + staging alert + dashboard tiles (2d), Noah -> canary plan (5% traffic) + rollback rules (1d). Please update the postmortem ticket with ETAs and tag @oncall for rollout time windows.
Zara L.: Draft PR: https://git.redwood/runtime/pulls/2102 - includes eviction tweak and hotspot metrics. Running perf job now.
Ethan B.: Infra PR: https://git.redwood/infra/pulls/1421 - adds burst token + cooldown change. Staging tile: https://dash.redwood/s/ops/operational-threshold. Canary ready once runtime patch lands.
Noah G.: Canary checklist: (1) update internal SLO docs, (2) canary = 5% traffic, (3) rollback if p95 > 350ms for 10m OR error-rate increase > 0.5%. Any concerns?
Zara L.: No concerns. Perf run shows ~19% p95 tail improvement on synthetic load. Ill finalize the PR tomorrow morning.
Ethan B.: Scheduling 09:30 UTC canary. Ill ping CS to add the incident annotation to the public SLO dashboard.
Noah G.: Thanks team. Well reconvene post-canary to decide whether to keep the temporary operational threshold for the 14-day window or restore original SLO math. Logging closure items in the postmortem ticket now. :thumbsup:
